title: Only Trust Him
lyrics: [G]Come, every soul by sin oppressed, There's mercy with the [D]Lord,
And [G]He will surely [C]give you rest, By [G]trusting in [D7]His [G]word.
[G]Only trust Him, [C]only trust [G]Him, Only trust Him [D]now;
[G]He will save you, [C]He will save you, [G]He will save [D7]you [G]now.
For Jesus shed his precious blood
Plunge now into the crimson flood
Yes, Jesus is the truth, the way,
Come, then, and join this holy band,
To dwell in that celestial land,
